# I will get the songs from each playlist using show_playlist API.
# Then I will identify songs that are in the old_songs list.
# I will collect the songs to remove from each playlist and also collect them to add to the archived playlist.

songs_to_archive = []  # To collect songs to add to archived playlist
songs_to_remove_by_playlist = {}  # playlist_id -> list of song ids to remove

for playlist in all_playlists:
    playlist_id = playlist["playlist_id"]
    if playlist_id == archived_playlist_id:
        # Skip the archived playlist itself
        continue
    playlist_details = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_access_token)
    if "songs" not in playlist_details:
        continue
    songs_in_playlist = playlist_details["songs"]
    to_remove = []
    for song in songs_in_playlist:
        if song["title"] in old_songs:
            to_remove.append(song["id"])
            songs_to_archive.append(song["id"])
    if to_remove:
        songs_to_remove_by_playlist[playlist_id] = to_remove

print(f"Songs to remove from playlists: {songs_to_remove_by_playlist}")
print(f"Total songs to archive: {len(songs_to_archive)}")
